CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinates) and its presentation (coordinate set) and representation status (origin) are all explicitly given for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim tied to the identified contents' organization/access.

C.rationale: The report names represented contents (coordinate sets) and attributes (red/blue) for explicit referents.

D.rationale: Representation-status/origin fields (e.g. completed_record, history_estimate) are given separately from the coordinate content.

O.rationale: Coordinate sets show how the content is presented/organized (spatial pattern) in the represented state.
